# Air-Cooled ATF Cooler Performance Limits

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Drive at speeds between 45 and 70 mph for maximum efficiency. [t25]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Every step below is supported by the source, but the verifier could not confirm this is the whole procedure. Steps or precautions may be missing; read the source thread before relying on it.

1. Drive the vehicle at speeds between 45 and 70 mph for maximum efficiency.
2. Add an external fan if low-speed driving is frequent.

_Procedure reported by [t25]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Install an external fan to boost cooling capacity when vehicle speeds drop below 20-25 mph. [t25]
- Place any additional cooler where airflow is free-flowing, avoiding placement directly behind the factory air-cooler. [t25]
